description: `accounts prefer <seat>` is a silent state write (no herdr call, no stdout) that marks a seat preferred in `seatstate`; the next `accounts` listing shows a `⛁ prefer:` annotation line under that seat. `accounts prefer --clear` drops every seat's preference the same way, silently, and the annotation disappears from the next listing.

expect.stdout:
ACCOUNT            POOL             STATE        CONFIG DIR
explorer-seat      codex:test       available    CODEX_HOME=<DIR:codex-home>
explorer-seat: ahead of every same-kind sibling in its chains now.

ACCOUNT            POOL             STATE        CONFIG DIR
explorer-seat      codex:test       available    CODEX_HOME=<DIR:codex-home>
                   ⛁ prefer: ahead of its same-kind siblings (`accounts prefer --clear` to drop this)
cleared every seat preference — chains follow config order again.

ACCOUNT            POOL             STATE        CONFIG DIR
explorer-seat      codex:test       available    CODEX_HOME=<DIR:codex-home>
